message: Operation 'post-shipments-tracking' has semantic quality issues: vague_description, missing_context, missing_output_details, missing_side_effects, poor_ai_interpretability. The original description conflates the operation's purpose (submitting tracking data) with its use cases (appointment scheduling, monitoring). It lacks clarity on what inputs are accepted, what is returned, and the side effects of submission. The summary uses passive voice ('Create') which is less actionable than 'Submit'. Enhanced version clarifies: (1) the primary action (submitting a tracking event), (2) expected inputs (GPS data, location, facility info, resource metadata), (3) conditional requirements (ETA/ETAStatus exceptions), (4) response details (returns created event with 201 status), and (5) operational context (enables monitoring and scheduling). This improves AI agent interpretability for determining when to invoke this operation.

data.current_description: Provides real-time shipment tracking information using GPS data for appointment scheduling and shipment monitoring. ETA and ETAStatus are required unless currentEvent.eventType is FACILITY_ARRIVE or FACILITY_DEPART.
data.description_suggestion: Submits a new shipment tracking event to record the current status and location of a shipment. ETA and ETAStatus are required fields unless the currentEvent.eventType is FACILITY_ARRIVE or FACILITY_DEPART. Returns the created ShipmentTracking event with a 201 status code. This operation enables real-time shipment monitoring and supports appointment scheduling workflows.
